text:
dani-sales: FYI — Helix Labs POC: procurement returned the MSA with countersign but the signer entity is 'Helix Labs Inc' while the PO is issued to 'Helix Labs Solutions LLC'. They want us to sign MSA as 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' but procurement asks signatures to match PO entity. Need legal advice + procurement alignment. Orderform refs subscription id 12345 and PO# 4567.

maria-legal: Thanks. Do we have a fully executed PO? If not, ask buyer to reissue PO to match signer. If they insist on keeping the current PO, we can add an appendix mapping the entity — that tends to be lower friction than re-issuance. Need SOW/PO numbers and the buyer procurement contact.

ryan-ops: We have the PO PDF attached in the ticket (#4567). Quick check: PO has taxid 98-7654321 for Solutions LLC. DocuSign flow already in progress; the signer on DocuSign shows as an admin with name 'Helix Labs Inc'. Envelope ID: 0a1b2c.

sophie-ps: Client says reissuing the PO will be slow — legal on their side wants entity match to avoid revenue recognition issues. Can we accept a 'cross-entity acceptance clause' for the POC term only? Should be low friction and unblock going live for the trial.

maria-legal: We can do a limited acceptance: add clause 'Corporate Relationship Acknowledgement' plus a one-paragraph signature block clarifying which entity is the paying party. I'll draft a one-page addendum. Will need procurement contact + billing entity confirmation to include accurate legal names and tax IDs.

leo-security: Also flag: the DPA references data residency tied to Solutions LLC. If we add a mapping clause, make sure DPA references are updated or restated to avoid ambiguity — otherwise Security will request an explicit data controller/processor mapping for EU data.

dani-sales: OK — procurement contact: priya@helix.com; billing contact: trevor@helix.com. I'll ping them. Can you draft the addendum by EOD? Also, DocuSign status: current envelope ID 0a1b2c — let me know if we should void and re-send.

procurement-bot: Envelope 0a1b2c status: completed by Helix signer, waiting for internal countersignature. To void: API call POST /envelopes/0a1b2c/void. Reply with `/void` to proceed.

maria-legal: Don't void yet. I'll create the addendum and we can post it as an amendment referencing PO#4567 and the DocuSign envelope. If the envelope is completed on their side, we can countersign against the amendment instead of voiding. Drafting now.

ryan-ops: If the amendment changes the billing entity, Finance needs updated billing details to generate the invoice. Sophie, can you confirm whether POC invoice can be billed to Solutions LLC when signer is Inc? We need alignment for AR.

sophie-ps: Yes — POC invoice can bill Solutions LLC. Trevor already confirmed authorization to bill Solutions LLC. Maria, please include a 'billing entity' field and tax ID in the amendment so Finance has what it needs.

dani-sales: Thanks. I'll loop Priya and Trevor in the thread and attach the PO PDF. Maria — ping me when the draft is ready and I'll route to them for sign-off. :thumbsup:
